title: .sl/plans/<plan_id>.json
description: A query plan written by --emit-sql, finished from its stored results with --plan <plan_id>. A working file: gitignored, holds SQL and no data.

plan_id.description: A short hash of command, source, dialect and queries; equals the file name.

finish.description: The command that finishes the plan from its stored results: the emitting command with --plan <plan_id>.

command.description: The command that built the plan.

dialect.description: The SQL dialect of the queries.

id.description: Query id; results are stored under it.

max_rows.description: The most rows to fetch; a result of exactly this many rows is refused as possibly cut off.
